title: 05:55 Partner Pre-brief: Circuits 6, 7, 11, 12 Shutoff Decision at 06:00

fields.orgName: Sawmill County Office of Emergency Management

caller.name: Daniel Okoye
caller.label: Public Safety Partner Manager, Foothills Electric Cooperative (partner conference bridge)

transcript.speaker: Co-op Partner Manager
transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. This is Daniel Okoye with Foothills Electric for the pre-brief before Operations' six o'clock decision. On the line I have the county EOC, Pine Gulch Fire, the water district, Pine Gulch Medical Center and the school district. Here's where we are.

transcript.speaker: Co-op Partner Manager
transcript.text: Operations decides at six o'clock whether Circuits 6, 7, 11 and 12 go dead at 08:00. Coyote Ridge is gusting 38 miles an hour now and the forecast is over the trigger by mid-morning. If we go, plan on 24 to 48 hours. Before we can restore, crews have to patrol the whole circuit, and we need two hours with gusts under 35. That patrol needs daylight.

transcript.speaker: Co-op Partner Manager
transcript.text: County, please check your map against ours. Circuit 11 feeds PG-03. Circuit 12 feeds KS-04 and the Stonebridge pump station. Circuit 6 runs the CR-01 to CR-18 zones along Gulch Road. If any of those zones changes status, we need to hear it from you before we re-energize anything.

transcript.speaker: School Superintendent
transcript.text: This is Dr. Tamara Fuentes, Sawmill County Schools. Pine Gulch Elementary has 140 kids, and if the power goes the fire alarm panel only lasts as long as its battery. Do I hold classes, release early, or close?

transcript.speaker: Co-op Partner Manager
transcript.text: I'll hand that to the county. County, can you confirm the zone statuses for those circuits, and does Fire or the PIO have anything for the district before we go around the table?

transcript.speaker: School Superintendent
transcript.text: I need to send something to parents in the next half hour. I'd rather it match whatever the county is putting out.

voiceStyles.Co-op Partner Manager: Woman in her 50s, calm and organized, speaking from a briefing script, light wind noise on her end
voiceStyles.School Superintendent: Man in his 50s, polite but under pressure, talking fast, a hallway with children's voices behind him

instructorNote: Before you play this, tell the room it is 05:55 and the co-op decision is due at 06:00. Watch whether the EM checks PG-03, KS-04 and CR-01 to CR-18 against the zone map, confirms that none is under Evacuation Warning, and commits to report any status change before re-energization (co-op plan section 5). Also watch whether the Fire Chief raises the 8-hour generator at the Kestrel Springs pump station, and whether the PIO agrees joint wording with the district while the school decision stays with the district.
